outcome: adverse events to maternal and fetal well-being
cohort: 100 pregnant women with diagnosed SLE and 100 age-matched normal pregnant women without any obvious complications
finding: Prepregnancy disease-free interval is the most important criteria to minimize complications in pregnant women with SLE.
mod_finding: A higher proportion of women in the SLE group (53.25%) underwent cesarean section compared to the control group (25%).
